messages:
zoe: Quick thread  ran a short audit: when we allow dynamic packing across FP8/INT8/4bit, some long-context workloads show elevated late_token_fuzz. Seems correlated with KV fragmentation + occasional size-mismatch evictions. Thoughts?
mike: Can you quantify "elevated"? numbers?
zoe: degscore on a curated eval set up ~0.07 -> 0.15 after mixed packing for sequences >1500 tokens. tail_error and user complaints match.
priya: Maybe we need a precision-priority shim: warm requests (hot prefixes) get same-bit packing; cold ones can be opportunistic. Add hysteresis so short blips don't flip buckets.
tomas: Agree on hysteresis. Also two lower-level fixes: (1) serialize KV entries with a tiny header describing quant format so we avoid deserialization mismatches; (2) maintain per-quant namespace to reduce eviction noise. Both increase memory and slightly reduce cache efficiency.
mike: The header approach is neat — small overhead per-entry but prevents silent corruption. Per-quant namespaces sound heavier. Which do we try first?
zoe: Header + hysteresis scheduler first (low deploy risk). If deg stays high, enable soft namespace partition and measure impact.
priya: Hysteresis proposal: if a customer bucket's rolling deg_delta > 0.05 over Tmin=3min, prefer same-bit scheduling for that bucket for Thold=10min. Clear after 3 consecutive windows below 0.02. We'll need to store per-bucket state in scheduler.
tomas: Scheduler state size should be bounded; use LRU eviction of bucket-state and sample-based counters. Also sample one in N requests to record "bits_seq" and "kv_hdr_mismatch" for later analysis.
mike: Telemetry: add fields - "deg_delta", "tail_error", "bits_seq", "kv_hdr", "kv_fragment":boolean, "bucket_state" tag. Make sure events are cheap.
telemetry-bot: Staging schema created: quant_hysteresis.v1. Patch deployable to staging at 6299999980.
priya: For evaluation, we should run: (A) header-only 20% traffic shadow; (B) header + hysteresis 10% canary; (C) header + soft-namespace 5% if (B) shows improvement. Measure tokens/sec delta and deg delta per-bit.
zoe: Also want a replay plan: capture compact replay tuple (model_name, prompt_fingerprint, seed, initial_kv_digest, bits_seq) so infra can reproduce exact mixed/mono batches. Replays should be run with exact header semantics.
mike: Dev notes: minimal header format: 1 byte magic + 1 byte version + 1 byte quant_id + 2 bytes entry_len (big-endian). Keep header 5 bytes to minimize blowup.
tomas: Good. For soft-namespace, use top-level allocator partitions (e.g., 80% shared, 20% reserved by quant when needed) rather than strict split. Easier to roll back.
priya: Action items: zoe + mike implement KV header + microbench (mem/throughput), priya + tomas implement hysteresis scheduler + bounded bucket-state, telemetry-bot will enable v1 schema on staging. Ops: run shadowing canary per plan.
zoe: I'll open the PRs and attach microbench graphs. Please add any extra telemetry fields to the schema PR. :rocket:
